shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && sed -n 1,80p references/package-routing.md; echo ------; rg -n -i "navigation|aside|table|sidebar|app shell" references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo -----; cat rules/hallucination-traps.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls node_modules/@tanstack node_modules/@hello-pangea; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30; npm ls --depth=0 2>&1 | head -30
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30; npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/i18n @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @bem-react/classname lodash 2>&1 | tail -15; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/{navigation,table,icons,uikit}/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls navigation/build/docs/components; ls table/build/docs 2>&1 | head; rg -n -i "reorder|grouping|getGroupedRowModel|expanded|enableRowSelection|Required setup|styles" table/README.md | head -50
sed -n 1,130p table/README.md; sed -n 255,347p table/README.md; sed -n 453,480p table/README.md

rg -n -i "css|styles" navigation/README.md | head; rg -n "useRowSelectionFixedHandler" -r . table/build --glob '*.d.ts' | head -5; rg -n "getGroupTitle|ColumnReorderingProviderProps" table/build --glob '*.d.ts' | head; grep -n '"exports"' -A25 navigation/package.json | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && cat components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts; rg -n "enableColumnOrdering|columnOrder|enableColumnReorder|disableReorder|isReorderable" -r . --glob '*.d.ts' | head; rg -n "selectionColumn" . --glob '*.d.ts' | head -3; sed -n 1,60p components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls esm | grep -E "^(House|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|Cubes3|Receipt|Bag)\.js$"; cd ../navigation/build/esm && rg -n "logo\??:|menuItems|renderContent|multipleTooltip|enableTooltip" components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head; rg -n "interface MenuItem" -A40 components/types.d.ts | head -60
sed -n 1,40p components/Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -l "interface LogoProps" .; rg -n "ColumnDef|columnOrder|getRowId" ../../../table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.d.ts | head
